title: Covering design C(23,6,6,15)
statement: Find 6-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 23} such that every 15-subset meets some block in at least 6 points, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 59 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 6 distinct points from 1..23 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(23,6,6,15) = 59 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-26 (before it 60); read 6 Nov 2026

provenance.revision: repository read on the date given

score: the number of blocks (smaller is better)
quantavane_note: our object is the best known entry of the source table
